dedupe_keys.name: cox s bazar health facility registry for rohingya refugee camps iscg health sector 2018

description: This registry lists the health facilities operating in the Rohingya refugee camps and sites of Ukhia and Teknaf upazilas in Cox's Bazar district, Bangladesh. It was compiled by the Health Sector of the Inter Sector Coordination Group, which coordinates the humanitarian response in Cox's Bazar, and shared on the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX). Two Excel releases are available, dated 23 September 2018 and 13 November 2018, so users can see how the list of facilities in the camps changed over those weeks. HDX files the dataset as a registry. The workbooks are small (about 60 to 90 kB) and free to download without registration under a Creative Commons Zero public domain dedication. Coverage is the refugee camps and sites in the two upazilas, not the wider district. Caveats: the lists are snapshots from late 2018, when facilities were opening, merging and closing quickly, and HDX gives no field descriptions, so the columns must be read from the files. Simulation uses: locations of camp health services for access, surge and outbreak response models in a dense humanitarian setting. Related records: the March 2018 Cox's Bazar health facility and service availability mapping (data-iscg-cox-bazar-health-facility-mapping-2018) comes from the same coordination structure, and the Kutupalong camp fire evacuation study (case_study-kutupalong-camp-fire-evacuation-simulation) models the same camps.
